result.reason: The added clause reaches the preferred insurance position: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence/2M aggregate, E&O at USD 2M, cyber/privacy at USD 5M for this data-processing vendor, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. It leaves the force majeure provision unchanged and is professionally drafted. However, requiring every policy to continue for one year after termination exceeds the playbook and is not necessary to implement the requested position.
